Container.Name: zapconvert
Container.Overview: Private file converter for your home server. Convert, compress, merge, split and protect PDFs, Office documents, images, spreadsheets, audio and video. Most tools run inside the browser, so files never leave the device; Office, PDF to Word or Excel and media conversions go through the two companion containers, which process files in RAM and never store them. No ads, no tracking, no accounts.[br][br]Needs zapconvert-gotenberg and zapconvert-media-worker on the same custom Docker network. Install those first.
Container.Requires: 1. Create the network once in the Unraid terminal: docker network create zapconvert[br]2. Install zapconvert-gotenberg and zapconvert-media-worker on that network.[br]3. Install this container on the same network.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Lifetime Pass key
Config.Description: Optional. A Lifetime Pass key unlocks Self-Hosted Pro (1 GB server uploads, no footer credit) for every user of this instance.

Config.Name: Media worker token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret. Use the same value in zapconvert-media-worker (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: Gotenberg URL
Config.Description: Address of the zapconvert-gotenberg container on the shared network.

Config.Name: Media worker URL
Config.Description: Address of the zapconvert-media-worker container on the shared network.

Config.Name: Community upload limit (MB)
Config.Description: Per-file limit for server conversions without Pro. Blank means 100.

Config.Name: Pro upload limit (MB)
Config.Description: Per-file limit for server conversions with Pro. Blank means 1024.
